new_libraries.name: PicoENC28J60
new_libraries.author: Lukasz Janyst (original driver), Ângelo Moisés Alves (Arduino port)
new_libraries.sentence: ENC28J60 Ethernet for the Raspberry Pi Pico (RP2040), with SPI on any pins through a PIO program.
new_libraries.paragraph: Send and receive raw Ethernet frames, or use TCP/IP through the lwIP stack of the arduino-pico core: DHCP, WiFiClient, WebServer and the rest, with or without the chip's INT pin. Based on pico-enc28j60 by Lukasz Janyst (https://github.com/ljanyst/pico-enc28j60), whose PIO SPI program and ENC28J60 driver it uses.

new_libraries.name: UARDECS_ESP32C3
new_libraries.author: Takehiko Hoshi, Hideto Kurosaki and Ken-ichro Yasuba
new_libraries.sentence: A library that provides communication capabilities compliant with the "Ubiquitous Environment Control System (UECS)" standard, which is widely used in protected horticulture in Japan.
new_libraries.paragraph: This library facilitates UECS sweet application development on the ESP32C3 chip board by providing UDP packet broadcast communication via Wi-Fi and internet web server functionality, all compliant with the UECS communication protocol. It supports the ESP32C3-OLED, XIAO ESP32C3, and compatible boards. Please refer to LICENSE.md for licensing information.

library.name: note-cpp
library.author: Mat McGowan
library.sentence: Typed C++ SDK for the Blues Notecard.
library.paragraph: Type-safe, compile-time checked API for all Notecard endpoints. Header-only. Supports Arduino, PlatformIO, and CMake.
